name: Battle Music Restore
description: This patch restores the battle theme to every monster formation/encounter that previously had it removed (where no battle song would play). It should work fine with the 'random battle song' patch.

name: Random Battle Song
description: This patch changes all the regular battle theme song instances to 8 possible random choices of 8 battle theme songs that exist in the hack.

name: Soundtrack B
description: Soundtrack B currently has 203 changed songs. By default the game starts with 'soundtrack a'.
